svg.title: Moonblade — an anthropomorphic cat holding a sword
svg.desc: A moonlit rooftop: an orange tabby cat in a teal kimono and red headband stands in a sword stance, holding a katana aloft. The tail swishes, ears twitch, the eyes blink, petals fall, fireflies drift, and the blade catches the moonlight.

g.text: hover the steel · tap it for a flash
